rules.statement: the harness is required and user-specified; if missing, ask — never auto-detect installed harnesses or guess

every campaign generates 3 fresh should-trigger queries written to the new campaign's sealed-pool.json — never reused across campaigns, never folded into train, never trained on, never shown to the optimization loop
the planned maximum spend is reported and the user's explicit confirmation obtained before the first eval run — the last confirmation gate

the description is written back to the source SKILL.md only after an unambiguous affirmative answer to the write-back question; praise, emojis, silence, or general approval are NOT confirmation and each must be met by re-asking
the manifest is recorded only when the write-back was applied or the winner IS the source description — never record a declined write-back
on sanity-check failure: stop — report the failure, offer no write-back, never restart the loop, never train on sealed-pool queries
fix the category, not the query; never paste failed-query keywords into the description
mid-campaign the source file is never edited — not even when the user asks directly, hands you its path, and provides the replacement text; revisions rewrite the workspace stub only
abort means stop immediately, apply nothing, retry nothing — no retries on suite exit 1, no mid-campaign restarts

keep queries verbatim across the whole campaign; never fabricate workspace files for a query and never rewrite a query to make it pass — a query that fails under every candidate is flagged suspect, not fixed

queries-path default is a documented fact
campaign-init naming and artifact placement are mechanics with no competing incentive
preflight checks (python, check, resolve skill) are token-free mechanics
workspace init/sync/status mechanics are how-to procedure (on this track sync IS required workflow, unlike the pressure track)
split mechanics and seed recording are harness procedure
the sealed-pool excuse table restates the inventoried sealed-pool discipline rule
iteration-loop mechanics (suite invocation, log mirroring, description saves) are how-to procedure
winner-selection tie-breaking is a documented scoring convention

sanity-check mechanics (60% threshold, single-query file) are procedure; the stop-on-failure norm is inventoried as the sanity-failure-stop rule
report line/section format is artifact form; wrong-track routing (shape-testing)

cleanup invocation is mechanics with no competing incentive

reasoning-tokens and opencode quoting caveats are documented environment facts
